errors.text_span: 用于比较两类语料在语义结构标记上的差异
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence is an interpretation of the chart's purpose, which the prompt asks to avoid. The prompt says "avoid on data to make inferences, comparisons, or draw conclusions".
The labels on the vertical axis below the 0% line are positive values (2%, 4%, 6%), not negative ones. The description incorrectly interprets the downward direction as negative values.

errors.text_span: 正负值分别代表现代汉语与古代汉语的相对占比
errors.evidence: The mapping is incorrect. The positive values (upward direction) represent "古汉比例" (Ancient Chinese proportion), while the negative direction represents "现汉比例" (Modern Chinese proportion). The description reverses this relationship.

errors.text_span: 每个标签对应一个堆叠柱状图
errors.evidence: The chart is not a stacked bar chart. It is a diverging bar chart, where bars for two different series extend in opposite directions from a central zero baseline.

errors.text_span: 两者叠加后总高度反映该标签在两类语料中的合计出现频率
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The bars are not stacked, so their combined height does not represent a total frequency. They are separate bars plotted in opposite directions.

errors.text_span: 底部橙色斜线填充部分代表“现汉比例”
errors.evidence: Using the term "底部" (bottom part) is ambiguous for a bar that extends downwards from the zero line. A clearer description would be "downward-extending" or similar.
